title: 3 Enoch, or The Hebrew Book of Enoch
author: Hugo Odeberg (ed)
description: Hugo Odeberg's edition of the Hebrew Book of Enoch introduces a major work of Jewish heavenly-ascent literature. It explores the figure of Metatron, angelic orders and the visionary encounter with the divine throne.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/3enochorhebrewbo00unse).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
